meta.name: compliance-checker
meta.description: Check affiliate content for FTC compliance and platform rules. Triggers on: "check my content for compliance", "FTC disclosure check", "is this legal", "review for compliance", "check affiliate disclosure", "am I FTC compliant", "audit my content", "compliance review", "legal check", "platform rules check", "check before publishing", "disclosure audit", "review my ad copy".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查你的联盟营销内容是否符合FTC法规和平台规则
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要确保你的推广内容合法合规
copy.tagline_en: Check your affiliate content for FTC compliance and platform rules
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure your promotional content is legally compliant

howto.what: Claude 会检查你提供的内容（如帖子、博客、广告）是否遵守 FTC 法规和平台规则，找出披露缺失、禁止性声明等问题，并给出严重评级和具体修改建议，最后输出一份合规评分报告。
howto.when: 当你说出“检查合规”、“FTC 披露”等关键词，或在发布前要求审核内容时触发。

say.text: 检查我新写的这篇博客是否合规。
say.note: Claude 会扫描内容并给出合规评分与修改建议。

say.text: 我这条推文需要加 #ad 吗？
say.note: Claude 会检查推文中是否有联盟链接并判断披露是否必要。

say.text: 审核这段广告文案有没有违规声明。
say.note: Claude 会识别收入保证、虚假稀缺等禁止性用语。

howto.what_en: Claude will scan your content (e.g., posts, blogs, ads) for FTC compliance and platform rules, identify issues like missing disclosures or prohibited claims, rate their severity, and output a compliance scorecard with suggested fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say phrases like 'check my content for compliance' or 'FTC disclosure check', or request a review before publishing.

say_en.text: Check this blog post for compliance.
say_en.note: Claude scans and returns a scorecard with issues.

say_en.text: Does my tweet need a #ad disclosure?
say_en.note: Claude checks for affiliate links and disclosure requirements.

say_en.text: Audit this ad copy for prohibited claims.
say_en.note: Claude flags income guarantees, fake scarcity, etc.
